| Oh no. I'll give it. Not in the hope you'll succeed... Bah! In that, there's slim chance. I give just to see that restless energy unleashed. So much soul, found and formed. Generations of it, all going to waste. Better it's given a chance to blaze.

The <b>Hermit's Soul</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i> [[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The <b>Hermit's Soul</b> can be given to the [[Caretaker]] in [[Songclave]] along with the [[Maiden's Soul]], [[Seeker's Soul]], and [[Snare Setter]] to complete the <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i> Wish.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Sherma 07.png!Location in Choral Chambers
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Caretaker 01.png!Caretaker in Choral Chambers
}}

== How to Acquire ==
After accepting the <i>[[Silk and Soul]]</i> wish, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] must travel to the Bellways underneath [[Bellhart]] and speak with the [[Bell Hermit]] who will give her the <b>Hermit's Soul</b>.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bell Hermit 01.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Bellhart 06.png!Bell Hermit in Bellhart
}}
